newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ANALYSTS SEES 1997 GDP 4 PCT, Q3 CPI 14 PCT.
newsitem.headline: ANALYSTS SEES 1997 GDP 4 PCT, Q3 CPI 14 PCT.

text.p: The Estonian Institute for Market Research on Thursday forecast that GDP will grow by four percent this year and inflation will fall to 14 percent by the third quarter.
The institute said in its latest survey that price increases have been stopped in the non-regulated sector.
"However, sudden changes may bring up regulated prices, as the price increase was postponed here last year," the institute said. Inflation at the end of 1996 was 14.8 percent.
The institute also predicted GDP to grow by four percent this year and 3.5 percent in 1996.
Experts said the overall economic situation has improved during the first quarter compared to the same period last year.

"Interest rates in banks have decreased, inflation has slowed down, the securities and credit market broadened, savings increased and the trade balance worsened," the institute said of the developments during the first quarter.
